mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO rise over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% and sustained for 3 months), the Federal Reserve's policy shift reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS has risen over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI index above 238 (indicating accelerating inflation) triggers the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 238, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% over the past 3 months signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has risen over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
